title: Q4 Migration Plan
content:
# Q4 Migration Plan

## Overview
This document outlines the Q4 platform migration from monolith to microservices-ready architecture.

## Timeline
- Week 1: Database migration to PostgreSQL with pgvector
- Week 2: API service migration to FastAPI
- Week 3: Frontend migration to Next.js
- Week 4: Integration testing and cutover

## Key Decisions
The team decided to use a strangler-fig pattern for the migration. We will maintain the old API during transition.

## Risks
- Data consistency during dual-write period
- Provider rate limits during initial sync
- Embedding model dimension mismatch

## Rollback
If migration fails, revert to the previous architecture using the migration rollback script.
